paragraphs: The 125i was part of the F20/F21-generation 1 Series, produced from 2012 to 2019. It uses the N20 — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine that was a mainstay of BMW's F-series range during that period. The N20 was known for its solid power output and efficiency, though timing chain guide wear became a recognised pattern on earlier cars (pre-2015). The later F40 125i switched to the B48 engine, but that's a different car entirely — this page is for the F20/F21 model with the N20.
about.boldParagraph: The 125i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine fitted to the 125i from 2012 to 2019. Known for timing chain guide wear on earlier cars — see the callout above. We replace the timing chain, guides, tensioners and gaskets as standard on every N20 rebuild.
